name: NIH Documents: Biosketch, Current and Pending (Other) Support, and Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) Certification
intro_text: Each year, the Center collects everyone’s Current and Pending (Other) Support for its Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) to NIH. If you’re named on the Notice of Award, NIH also needs your biosketch and a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) certification. Please make each document in SciENcv with NIH’s Common Forms, and upload the certified PDFs here. If you’re an Other Significant Contributor, you’ll see only the biosketch upload.

about: Each year the Center reviews the Current and Pending (Other) Support of its project leaders, core directors, and Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI).
People named on the Notice of Award also give a biosketch and a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) certification for the Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR).
Other Significant Contributors give a biosketch only.

questions.prompt: Will there be, in the next budget period, either (1) a reduction of 25% or more in the level of effort from what was approved by the agency for the PD/PI(s) or other senior/key personnel designated in the Notice of Award, or (2) a reduction in the level of effort below the minimum amount of effort required by the Notice of Award?
questions.help_text: This is RPPR question D.2.a, word for word. In short: will your CNAP effort drop by 25% or more next budget year (starting June 1)? NIH treats a Yes as a request for prior approval. If the drop has already happened, please tell the evaluator, because a separate request is needed.

questions.prompt: If you answered Yes, please describe the change. Please include your current and planned calendar months and when the change starts.

sections.title: Current and Pending (Other) Support
sections.instructions: NIH requires that your Current and Pending (Other) Support be built in SciENcv, using NIH’s Common Form. Please be sure to certify your Current and Pending (Other) Support in SciENcv before downloading it as a PDF. Please don’t flatten the PDF, because NIH checks the certification. Your ORCID iD must show in the Persistent Identifier (PID) section. The links below have NIH’s instructions. If you need help with SciENcv, please contact your Central Office grant specialist. Unsure who your Central Office grant specialist is? Start with Morgan Wills at mkwills@ksu.edu; she can point you in the right direction.

questions.prompt: Current and Pending (Other) Support: Common Form (certified PDF from SciENcv)

sections.title: Biosketch
sections.instructions: Because you are listed on CNAP’s Notice of Award (NoA) as Key Personnel or as an Other Significant Contributor, NIH requires your updated biosketch. NIH requires that your biosketch be built in SciENcv. Please use NIH’s Biographical Sketch Common Form with the NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement, combined in one PDF. Please be sure to certify your biosketch in SciENcv before downloading it as a PDF. Please don’t flatten the PDF. The links below have NIH’s instructions. If you need help with SciENcv, please contact your Central Office grant specialist. Unsure who your Central Office grant specialist is? Start with Morgan Wills at mkwills@ksu.edu; she can point you in the right direction.

questions.prompt: Biosketch: Common Form with the NIH Supplement (certified PDF from SciENcv)

sections.title: Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP) certification
sections.instructions:
Every year, NIH requires each senior/key person to certify in the Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) whether they are a party to a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP).

Please follow these four steps:
- Please download your form below.
- Please sign it with an Adobe digital signature. The guide below walks you through it.
- Please flatten it, as NIH asks. Print it to PDF (Microsoft Print to PDF on Windows, or Save as PDF on a Mac).
- Please upload the flattened PDF here.

sections.title: Foreign-activity documents (only if you have any)

questions.prompt: Supporting documentation: copies of contracts for foreign appointments, or for employment with a foreign institution (optional, one flattened PDF)
questions.help_text: NIH takes these as a separate attachment, not inside your Current and Pending (Other) Support. Please leave this blank if you have none.

_source: MW 2026-10-27: PPLs, RPLs, core directors and the CNAP Director upload SciENcv biosketch and Current and Pending once a year; MFTRP certification and D.2.a in the same task; optional foreign-activity documents. Piestar thread (Apr 2026) for D.2 and MFTRP. SciENcv Common Forms required for RPPRs from Jan 25, 2026 (Stanford ORA notice). Wording per NOT-OD-26-018 (Common Forms; NIH Biosketch Supplement; don't flatten SciENcv PDFs; annual MFTRP certification in RPPR G.1 as a flattened PDF named MFTRPcert_[Name].pdf; supporting documentation as a separate flattened attachment) and NOT-OD-26-033 (enforced from May 8, 2026). MW 2026-10-27: Current and Pending from everyone on the list; biosketch and MFTRP only from people named on the Notice of Award (Person.senior_key, default PD/PI and RP Leaders), via a hidden site-set question. MW 2026-11-02: Other Significant Contributors get the task with the biosketch only.
